description: React component for displaying detailed DID (Decentralized Identifier) information in a modal dialog, including agent DID, reasoners, skills, and technical details, with support for copying DIDs and viewing DID documents.

classes.name: DIDInfoModalProps
classes.description: Props for the DIDInfoModal component, including nodeId, isOpen, and onClose.

classes.name: ReasonerDIDCard
classes.description: Component displaying information about a reasoner with DID, including capabilities and creation date.

classes.name: SkillDIDCard
classes.description: Component displaying information about a skill with DID, including tags and creation date.

methods.name: DIDInfoModal
methods.description: Main React component rendering a modal with DID information, tabs for overview, reasoners, skills, and technical details, with support for copying DIDs and viewing documents.

methods.name: handleCopyDID
methods.description: Handles copying a DID to clipboard and showing feedback.

methods.name: handleViewDIDDocument
methods.description: Fetches and displays a DID document in a new window.
